findings.fix: Make this equivalence private if it is only proof scaffolding for the uniqueness/disjointness/open/irreducible results, or add public characterization lemmas tying it on affine charts to minimal primes below `p`/`zeroLocus` and use those lemmas rather than the body.
findings.issue: `stalkMinimalPrimesEquivIrreducibleComponentsContaining` is public but has no characteristic API describing which component a minimal prime maps to; its body depends on `X.affineCover.idx`, `Classical.choose`, `isoSpec`, and several private equivalences, so downstream users cannot reason about it without unfolding implementation choices.

summary: The main irreducibility theorem is an appropriate public product, but the PR exposes an uncharacterized equivalence built from arbitrary affine-cover choices. That leaves downstream users with a public name they cannot use semantically without depending on its construction.
